title: the error helpers cannot name an exception class
author: Claude-JG
description: CHECKandTHROW\, CHECKandTHROWstring and SysError can only throw EXUexception\, so a check cannot say what kind of error it states - and the measurement of #2520 shows no helper is one kind (CHECKandTHROW is 27 percent user-facing\, SysError has 10 user sites). The type has to be choosable at the CALL SITE. revision2026 step R6.3.3.
releaseNotes: CHECKandTHROW and CHECKandTHROWstring take an optional last argument naming the exception class, PyErrorType carries nine kinds and ThrowPyErrorType is the one place that turns one into a throw, SysError defaults to internalError. The MSVC traditional preprocessor needs the selection AND the call expanded together. Six SysError sites in PyMatrixVector.h whose message says check your Python code opt out - they were six of the ten user-facing SysError sites the triage of #2520 had named. revision2026 step R6.3.3.
